page.notes: The first word of the page, "men", is a fragment carried over from the previous page and is read with a [?]. Greek κοινωνία and κοινωνίαν are copied from the scan in Greek letters. "Gratias agimus]" is an italic lemma at the start of a paragraph inside the text column, so it is kept in the text and not treated as a margin note. The printed "Theffalonicensibus" and "quib'" are kept as printed. The text is cut off at the foot of the page, with no catchword shown.
